'''Rorhy Etamuhs''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[War against Zakuul|revolt]] against the [[Eternal Empire]]. In [[3630 BBY]] he was part of the forces [[War on Iokath|brought]] by the Republic [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] [[Jace Malcom]] to [[Iokath]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rorhy Etamuhs appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a vendor on Iokath for Republic-affiliated players.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
